name: Allegan County, MI
findings: Allegan County has 458 nonprofit organizations. 208 of them (45%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 163 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (32% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Allegan County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Religious organizations stand out for public events
observations.text: 37 religious organizations here list public events, compared with about 16 in similar places of this size.
